entries.title: Psalms 43:1
segments: ¶Judge me, O God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation: O deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man. {ungodly: or, unmerciful} {the deceitful...: Heb. a man of deceit and iniquity}

words.text: . {ungodly: or, unmerciful} {the deceitful...: Heb. a man of deceit and iniquity}

entries.title: Psalms 43:2
segments: For thou [art] the God of my strength: why dost thou cast me off? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?

words.text: : why dost thou cast me off

entries.title: Psalms 43:3
segments: O send out thy light and thy truth: let them lead me; let them bring me unto thy holy hill, and to thy tabernacles.

entries.title: Psalms 43:4
segments: Then will I go unto the altar of God, unto God my exceeding joy: yea, upon the harp will I praise thee, O God my God. {my exceeding...: Heb. the gladness of my joy}

words.text: . {my exceeding...: Heb. the gladness of my joy}

entries.title: Psalms 43:5
segments: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope in God: for I shall yet praise him, [who is] the health of my countenance, and my God.
